## Description
Describe your changes and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
Please check all that apply:
- [ ] `cd apps/api && npx nest build` passes with zero TypeScript errors.
- [ ] `cd apps/api && npm test` passes all unit tests.
- [ ] Verified that no secrets, active API keys, or private datasets are committed.
- [ ] Verified with `gitleaks detect` locally.
